pokedexEntries.rb: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.ye: It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.

pokedexEntries.go: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.

pokedexEntries.si: It carries a seed on its back right from birth. As it grows older, the seed also grows larger.

pokedexEntries.cr: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seeds on its back in order to grow.

pokedexEntries.ru: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
